description: This PHP source file defines the SaleOrder controller class for the OpenCart admin report extension. It manages the display, saving, and generation of sale order reports within the admin interface, including handling permissions, loading dependencies, and rendering views.

classes.name: SaleOrder
classes.description: Controller class for managing sale order reports in OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the report form view, sets up breadcrumbs, titles, and loads header, footer, and other common components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report settings, checks permissions, updates settings, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Prepares and displays the sale order report page, including filtering options and report data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the sale order report list view.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates the report data based on filters, retrieves order data, and prepares pagination.
